title: U.S. House, District 24
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 24th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Open seat (Rep. Frederica Wilson retiring). Roster from WLRN, CBS Miami, Local 10, NBC6 and Florida Politics: Oliver Gilbert (D) vs. Te Mayonna Brown (R), who was unopposed in her primary. County makeup: Miami-Dade-based district; local coverage (Miramar News) describes it as also reaching into Broward. Sources: https://www.wlrn.org/government-politics/2026-08-18/oliver-gilbert-prevails-in-crowded-7-way-democratic-primary-to-succeed-rep-frederica-wilson ; https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/politics/decision/te-brown-is-projected-winner-of-floridas-district-24-republican-primary/3847775/ ; https://www.miramarflnews.com/news/local/article316923349.html Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Oliver Gilbert
candidates.occupation: Attorney and former prosecutor; Miami-Dade County Commissioner, District 1 (elected 2020; commission chair 2020-2024); former Mayor of Miami Gardens (2012-2020)
candidates.background: Oliver G. Gilbert III is an attorney and former prosecutor who served as mayor of Miami Gardens from 2012 to 2020 and was elected to the Miami-Dade County Commission (District 1) in 2020, chairing the commission from 2020 to 2024. Retiring U.S. Rep. Frederica Wilson endorsed him as her successor in June 2026. He won the seven-way Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary with about 34.5%, edging state Sen. Shevrin Jones (about 32%), with Kendrick Meek Jr. (about 17%), Rudolph Moise, Jean Monestime, Marshall Davis Sr. and Roderick Vereen trailing, despite more than $2 million in spending against him. He also serves in a leadership role on the FIFA World Cup 2026 Miami host committee.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary with ~34.5% over Shevrin Jones (~32%), Kendrick Meek Jr. (~17%) and four others (Florida Politics; Local 10; CBS Miami)

candidates.name: Te Mayonna Brown
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Real-estate developer, small-business owner and homeschooling mother
candidates.background: Te Mayonna (Te) Brown describes herself as a businesswoman, educator and real-estate developer. She was the only Republican to file for District 24, so the primary was canceled and she advanced to the November general election against Democrat Oliver Gilbert in a district that leans heavily Democratic. The Bulwark reported that she also lost a Republican U.S. House primary in Illinois earlier in 2026 and appears to be under indictment for felony wire fraud; her campaign reported raising about $313,000 to the FEC.
